column1: # The package set, and the single source of truth for it.
# BuildNugets.sh packs in this order, the release and pull-request workflows generate their
# package tables from it, the package tests read it, and the device-test runner scripts clear the
# local NuGet cache for every id listed here. Adding a package means adding a row here and a
# project under src/ - nothing else keeps a second copy of the list.
#   id      the NuGet package id, which is also the directory under src/ and the .csproj name
#   heads   reserved; every package here ships the full neutral+android+ios set, so this is -
#   deps    other ids in this repository it depends on, comma separated, or -
# The platform binding packages (SFMCSDK.Net.Android, SFMCSDK.Net.iOS) are deliberately NOT rows:
# they are published from their own repositories and arrive as pinned PackageReferences - see
